copy.tagline: 测试和验证应用内购与订阅功能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为移动应用测试 RevenueCat 的内购和订阅逻辑
copy.tagline_en: Test and verify in-app purchases and subscriptions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to test RevenueCat purchases and subscriptions in your mobile app

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你系统测试 RevenueCat 的购买和订阅功能，包括检查配置、调试沙盒、验证订阅生命周期事件（如购买、试用、续订、升级、取消、过期等），并生成可执行的 QA 测试计划。
howto.when: 当你需要测试或调试 RevenueCat 的购买、订阅、沙盒设置或恢复流程时触发，例如验证 entitlements 或编写 IAP 测试计划。

say.text: 检查我的 RevenueCat 沙盒配置是否正确。
say.note: Claude 会指导开启调试日志并检查产品 ID。

say.text: 我要测试订阅升级，该怎么做？
解释恢复购买时账户合并在哪些情况下会出错。
say.note: Claude 会讲解 TRANSFER 事件和 ID 冲突。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you systematically test RevenueCat purchases and subscriptions: checks config, debugs sandbox, verifies subscription lifecycle events (purchase, trial, renewal, upgrade, cancel, expire), and produces an actionable QA test plan.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to test or debug RevenueCat purchases, subscriptions, sandbox setup, or restore flow — for example, verifying entitlements or writing an IAP test plan.

say_en.text: Check my RevenueCat sandbox config is correct.
say_en.note: Claude guides enabling debug logs and checking product IDs.

say_en.text: How do I test a subscription upgrade?
say_en.note: Claude provides steps and expected event (PRODUCT_CHANGE).

say_en.text: Explain where account merger can fail during restore.
say_en.note: Claude covers TRANSFER events and ID conflicts.
